//: Standalone tsconfig for compiling worker.ts (+ its local models.ts import) to plain, directly Node-runnable JS. Deliberately separate from the root tsconfig.json (which has noEmit:true and moduleResolution:Bundler for Next's own build): worker.ts is loaded at runtime via `new Worker(path)`, entirely outside Next's and vitest's module graphs, so it needs a real .js file on disk — see lib/translation/translate.ts for why. Run via `npm run build:worker`.
